title: Pan-cancer integrative histology-genomic analysis via multimodal deep learning

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Pan-cancer integrative histology-genomic analysis via multimodal deep learning》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The rapidly emerging field of computational pathology has demonstrated promise in developing objective prognostic models from histology images.

evidence.text: The rapidly emerging field of computational pathology has demonstrated promise in developing objective prognostic models from histology images.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Pan-cancer integrative histology-genomic analysis via multimodal deep learning》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Our weakly supervised, multimodal deep-learning algorithm is able to fuse these heterogeneous modalities to predict outcomes and discover prognostic features that correlate with poor and favorable outcomes.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We present all analyses for morphological and molecular correlates of patient prognosis across the 14 cancer types at both a disease and a patient level in an interactive open-access database to allow for further exploration, biomarker discovery, and feature assessment.

evidence.text: Our weakly supervised, multimodal deep-learning algorithm is able to fuse these heterogeneous modalities to predict outcomes and discover prognostic features that correlate with poor and favorable outcomes.

We present all analyses for morphological and molecular correlates of patient prognosis across the 14 cancer types at both a disease and a patient level in an interactive open-access database to allow for further exploration, biomarker discovery, and feature assessment.
